correctness.rationale: Smoothness iff b Delta is nonzero follows from x*g(x^3), g=z^3+z^2+a z+b. Exact characteristic-seven multinomial expansion gives the 4x4 Cartier coefficient matrix and determinant 3 b^2 U V^2. On V=0, U=6 a^2(a-5)^2 and Delta=2 a(a+2)^3, showing rank at least two on every smooth fiber. Cartier is inverse-Frobenius semilinear; the correct stable-rank block is B^[7] B = W u^[7] v^T, where W=3ab^2+3(a+1)^7. Its zero/nonzero alternatives give the four p-rank/a-number strata. The factorization W|V=0 = 3(a-2)(a-3)(a+1)^2(a^3+3a^2-1), with exclusions from b Delta, proves exactly five smooth geometric parameter pairs. The standalone checker independently verifies all Cartier coefficients, factorization identities and 37 smooth F7 rational cases; infinite assertions rest on algebraic proof.

The related thesis treats global large a-number questions and does not state this classification. Targeted research-record and web searches returned no covering statement. Analogous computations in other prime characteristics do not imply this characteristic-seven Frobenius-twisted rank calculation; an unindexed equivalent result remains possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed or classically reparameterized computations could give an equivalent characteristic-seven locus.

value.rationale: The normalized family is the principal genus-four cyclic-order-six search family. The result classifies every smooth fiber by two independent Jacobian invariants, proves the uniform p-rank>=1 and a-number<=2 bounds, and isolates exactly five geometric p-rank-one parameters (including a genuinely non-prime-field irreducible cubic orbit). Detecting rank one requires a Frobenius-twisted stable-rank calculation beyond the ordinary Cartier rank or superspecial existence question. These precise small-characteristic boundary facts address a motivated arithmetic geometry gap rather than an arbitrary table recomputation; they neither solve a global moduli problem nor claim distinct abstract isomorphism types.
